clauses.quote: Association will determine whether the leave requires the payment of substitute costs.
An evaluation of all Association Leave days relative to the purpose and outcome of such leaves will be conducted by the Association and District administration prior to July 15 of each year.
clauses.subject_text: An evaluation of all Association Leave days relative to the purpose and outcome of such leaves

clauses.quote: Employees who legally adopt a child who has not previously been a member of the immediate household may take up to ten days of accumulated sick leave.
clauses.subject_text: Employees who legally adopt a child who has not previously been a member of the immediate household

clauses.quote: Damages in the amount of $1,000 will be levied against a teacher who fails to give the above required notice.
clauses.notes: Grammatical subject is 'Damages', but effectively imposes a financial penalty on teachers.

clauses.quote: All teachers under written contract shall be eligible for the group insurance programs provided by the board.
Teachers who submit the necessary insurance enrollment forms within their first 30 days of contract employment will be covered beginning 90 days from their contract hire date.
clauses.subject_text: Teachers who submit the necessary insurance enrollment forms within their first 30 days of contract employment

clauses.quote: Teachers who are late in submitting these enrollment forms (beyond the first 30 days of contract employment) must provide proof of insurability, wait until the following Open Enrollment period, or be subject to preexisting condition limitations depending on the insurance plan desired.
clauses.subject_text: Teachers who are late in submitting these enrollment forms (beyond the first 30 days of contract employment)

clauses.quote: Coverage shall be continuous for contract teachers who are continued in employment on a year-to-year basis.

Each insured teacher who terminates employment with the District shall have the benefit of such group insurance during the summer period and until August 31 for the employee group to which the teacher belonged, provided the teacher shall have completed the employment contract for the school year just ended.
clauses.subject_text: Each insured teacher who terminates employment with the District

clauses.quote: Otherwise, coverage shall end on the date specified in the insurance policy for teachers who terminate prior to the end of the school year.
